name: Jwalantam Karalam
text:
Jwalantam Karalam Maha Shaktim
Narasimham Bheeshanam Bhadra Murtim
Anugraham Shanthim Isham Namami
Sarva Raksha Karam Deva Devam
meaning: Blazing, fierce, of great power; Narasimha, terrible yet auspicious in form: I bow to the Lord who gives grace and peace, the god of gods who protects all.
note: A mantra from Sarvakali’s guru, invoking Narasimha together with Lakshmi and Bhudevi. It is not the published verse Ugram Veeram (also in this library), and it is kept as given, not forced into verse form.
source: Sarvakali’s teaching (her guru’s version); not a published text
pronunciation: jva-lan-tam ka-raa-lam ma-haa shak-tim; na-ra-sim-ham bhee-sha-nam bha-dra moor-tim; a-nu-gra-ham shaan-tim ee-sham na-maa-mi; sar-va rak-sha ka-ram day-va day-vam
